title: viewer_desktop.place_window
description: Place ONE window into a named screen region or explicit pixel bounds. Params: { target: windowId | appId, region?: <grammar enum>, bounds?: { x, y, width, height } } — exactly one of region | bounds. The region grammar (halves, quadrants, thirds, two-thirds, center, full) mirrors shell/src/utils/regionResolver.ts, the canonical resolver; explicit bounds are the escape hatch, never the default. Returns { ok, windowId, region?, bounds }.
